reported.label: Group order inflow up 33% YoY
reported.quote: Our group order inflows for Q1 FY26 at Rs.945 billion registered a YoY growth of 33%.

reported.label: Order book ₹6.13 trillion, up 25%
reported.quote: The order book as of June ‘25 is at Rs.6.13 trillion, up 25% as compared to June ‘24.

reported.label: Group revenue ₹637 billion, up 16%
reported.quote: The group revenues for Q1 FY26 at Rs.637 billion registered a strong YoY growth of 16%.

reported.label: PAT ₹36 billion, up 30%
reported.quote: Our reported PAT for Q1 FY26 is at Rs.36 billion, which is up 30% over Q1 of last year.

reported.label: Group EBITDA margin 9.9%
reported.quote: Our group level EBITDA margin without other income for Q1 FY26 is 9.9% vis-à-vis 10.2% in Q1 of the previous year.

reported.label: P&M EBITDA margin stable at 7.6%
reported.quote: the EBITDA margin in the Projects and Manufacturing business for Q1 FY26 is at 7.6% and is comparable as stable vis-à-vis Q1 of the previous year.

reported.label: NWC-to-revenue improved to 10.1%
reported.quote: our Net Working Capital to Revenue stood at 10.1%, reflecting a strong improvement of 380 basis points on a YoY basis.

reported.label: ROE 17%, up 230 bps YoY
reported.quote: our Return on Equity on a trailing 12-month basis as on June ‘25 is at 17%, improving by 230 basis points on a YoY basis.
